scope: Re-grades only the decision-readiness rows that the 2026-11-18 tree bears on. Every other row is carried forward unchanged from research/nfl-decision-readiness.json and labelled as such. Nothing here edits the shared register; changes are proposed to the integration owner.

adjudications.reason: NFL.com Terms section 1.3 (updated May 16, 2024) was re-read on 2026-11-18. It prohibits systematic retrieval of Services content to create or compile a collection, database or directory absent express prior written consent. No such consent is held in this repository. Remains Blocked until the owner records a decision (questions page, Q1).

Same terms clause as DR-29 (section 1.3, re-read 2026-11-18). A Wednesday-to-Friday dated injury history needs repeated retrieval of the injury report, which is the activity section 1.3 addresses. Remains Blocked pending the owner decision (questions page, Q1).

A past-season injury-report archive is a compilation of Services content, so section 1.3 applies as for DR-29. This desk does not decide whether a one-off, owner-approved archive would fall within the clause; that is an owner and legal question (questions page, Q1).

adjudications.outcome: Status kept; gate text is stale and proposed for correction
adjudications.reason: The register gate says snap counts 'are still not captured from any official source'. The committed snap-count desk contradicts this: 1,217 player rows for 13 Week 10 games (26 of the 28 clubs that played; LAC and BAL are absent) transcribed from the official NFL Game Book PDFs, of which 846 rows carry the printed 'Official' label and 371 rows (four games) carry the printed '(Unofficial)' label. Still open: the LAC@BAL Playtime table (desk flag SN-F03), the 'Unofficial' label question (SN-F01), a zero-row depth-vs-snap join (SN-F02), and a second slate.

The 32-club, club-by-club verification that clears this gate is not met. Snap counts exist for one week and 26 playing clubs (DR-31). Depth slots exist for 31 of 32 clubs when the two committed depth files are unioned (HOU absent). The snap-count desk records zero joinable depth-vs-snap rows. Week 10 had 14 fixtures (28 clubs). The four bye clubs (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB) had no game, and LAC and BAL played the Monday game whose Game Book was not in the capture. So the capture covers 26 of 28 playing clubs.
Snap counts are not yet a verified starter proxy for the clubs without printed charts. Same evidence and same gap as DR-11: one week, 26 clubs, no joinable depth rows, HOU without a committed chart.

Only two 2026 injury-report captures are committed (Week 7 and Week 10). Without a multi-season history of designations joined to official inactive lists, no play rate per designation can be computed, so 'Questionable' cannot yet be calibrated.

Route (a), official club depth charts, covers 31 of 32 clubs only when the two committed files are unioned: 27 clubs in nfl-availability-28ef and CHI, DEN, PHI, TB in nfl-skill-cfdd. HOU is absent from both. The union crosses two desks and is not one versioned register, so it must be confirmed at integration (DR-34). Route (b), snap counts, is now captured for 26 clubs for one week but is not verified as a depth source.

Transactions for November 2026 were captured in one read (about 12 rows, C672-TRADES-NOV-1118). The depth files carry checked_on and source_url columns but no roster-event version column (verified from the file headers), so depth rows are not yet versioned against the last official roster event.

A rendered what-changed ledger now exists (nfl-week11-6c72a9fa, session 6c72a9fa, F4): standings 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-18 (only BAL and LAC changed), a reserve-series delta, injury-report stability and schedule stability. The register gate says no diff is rendered, which is now contradicted. It is not Implemented because the clears_when condition needs at least two consecutive weekly pairs and a rating-change column; the ledger holds one pair and has no rating key.

Reserve/injured lists are now captured for November 2026 and October 2026 from nfl.com transactions. Each capture shows a 25-row rolling window. The November window contains Malik Willis (Dolphins, Reserve/Injured, dated 11/10), which is the named case. The capture is not complete for all 32 clubs, and the window rolls, so 'not listed' still cannot be read as 'available' from one capture.

The 2026 Official Playing Rules text on kickoffs and declared onside kicks was transcribed from media.nfl.com (nfl-integration-c815, rule 6-1-6): an onside kick may be declared at any time, it must be declared to the Referee (no surprise onside kick), the restraining line is the own 35 (own 20 on a safety kick), and the touchback spot from the 50 is the 20. Not yet done: the frequency of declared kicks (no official play-by-play is captured) and the priors filter itself.
